title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Nidorina 151 030/165 Reverse Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Nidorina card is a must-have for any serious Pokémon TCG collector! With a beautiful reverse holo finish, this card features the beloved character Nidorina in stunning detail. The card is made from high-quality card stock and is in standard size.

This card is from the Japanese set [SV2a] 151, manufactured by The Pokémon Company in 2023. It is a Stage 2 Pokémon card with the card number 030/165. The card is in Japanese language and features the artwork of Shinji Kanda. Suitable for ages 6 and up, this card is perfect for adding to your collection or for use in competitive play.
